description: This file defines the class LeaveTypeLeaveEntitlementUsageReport, which is responsible for generating a report about leave entitlement and usage per leave type. It includes methods for defining report headers, filters, data retrieval, validation rules, and access control. The class interacts with various entities and uses traits for authentication, user role management, leave period handling, and internationalization.
